code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild normocytic anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild elevations in basophils and monocytes. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits except for a mild ALT elevation. Findings suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration and possible chronic hypoxia; clinical correlation and further hematological evaluation are recommended.
